priorityList: Maintain Agony and Corruption at all times.
Cast Unstable Affliction if you are at maximum Soul Shards.
Ensure you have 2 or less Soul Shards before casting Dark Harvest to avoid overcapping shards.
Cast Dark Harvest whenever available with any periodic effect (Corruption, Agony, or Unstable Affliction) active on the target.
Cast Unstable Affliction to avoid capping shards.
Cast Drain Soul as a filler.
Do not overcap your Soul Shards (limit 5).
Do not pool Soul Shards unless heading into a damage window.
React to Nightfall procs to maximize damage and avoid overcapping the effect.
